title: Human Body Systems and the Water Cycle Unit Test
subject: science
unitTitle: The human body and water in nature

items.prompt: State the order in which food passes through the mouth, the stomach and the intestines, and say what happens at each stage.

points.text: Names the order mouth, then stomach, then intestines
States that food is chewed in the mouth, mixed in the stomach, and the good parts are taken out in the intestines

items.prompt: A drop of blood leaves the heart and travels to the body. Explain what happens to that drop next and why the heart never runs out of blood.

points.text: States the same drop travels back to the heart and goes round the loop again
Explains that the heart is a pump and blood is never used up, so no fresh blood is needed to replace it

items.prompt: State the process by which liquid water changes into water vapour at the surface of a pond.

points.text: Notes it happens at the surface and needs heat from the surroundings

items.prompt: A cold mirror held above a kettle of boiling water becomes covered in droplets. Explain how the droplets form.

points.text: States water vapour from the kettle touches the cold mirror
States the vapour loses heat and condenses into liquid droplets

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Answers use the correct system and process names and link each observation to a cause.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: System and process names are mostly correct but the cause link is incomplete.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: System and process names are missing or confused and no cause is given.
